DEF-17.title: G3 Currency-Aware Numerical Verification
DEF-17.description: Recognize currency symbols ($, €, £, ¥) and ISO codes (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Different currencies return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Same-currency conflicts return CONTRADICTED. Equivalence returns SUPPORTED.

DEF-18.title: G2 Coordinated Untrusted-Source Consensus Attack
DEF-18.description: Colluding untrusted documents cannot manufacture consensus or outvote clean documents. F4 catches prompt override variants. F5 for uncorroborated untrusted documents never exceeds 0.50. Swarm injection variants classified POISONED.

DEF-19.title: API Oversized Payload Semantics
DEF-19.description: POST requests exceeding 1 MiB return HTTP 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE. Malformed JSON below limit returns HTTP 400 INVALID_JSON. Unauthenticated requests return HTTP 401 UNAUTHORIZED.
